svg.title: Nothing overlapped
svg.desc: A timeline running left to right, with an arrow across the top labelled time, and two rows under it. The top row is the first thread: it takes lock_a, then takes lock_b, then releases both and exits. The bottom row is the second thread, and it starts only after the top row has finished, with a labelled gap between them saying the first thread has already exited. The second thread takes lock_b, then reaches for lock_a, and at that point a marker on the timeline says lockdep reports a cycle. A note underneath says the two rows never overlap, so no thread ever waited for another one, and that the report is about the order the locks were taken in rather than about anything that happened at the same time.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Nothing overlapped, and it is still a bug

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A deadlock needs the timing. A lock ordering bug does not.
